effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer with inherited effects, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] By trashing 1 card with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your Tamers with inherited effects are played, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your Tamers may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
